setupSteps.title: Install Git
setupSteps.verifierLabel: Git responds with a version number

setupSteps.title: Install Node LTS
setupSteps.verifierLabel: Node responds with a version number

steps.title: Check Git and Node
steps.body: Use Terminal. Node 20.9 or newer is required.
steps.verifierLabel: Git and Node respond with version numbers

steps.title: Install pnpm
steps.verifierLabel: pnpm responds with a version number

expect.prompt: In the shell, has `npm install -g pnpm` finished — a summary line such as "added 1 package" or "changed 1 package", with the prompt back and no error? Answer not done while it is still downloading, or if it stopped on a permissions error such as EACCES.

hints: If npm refused for lack of permission, reinstall Node from nodejs.org rather than re-running this with more privileges.
Finished but still not found? Open a fresh shell window so the new PATH is picked up.

steps.title: Copy FreeHarmony to this Mac
steps.command:
cd ~
if [ ! -d freeharmony/.git ]; then
git clone https://github.com/Blueturboguy07/freeharmony.git
fi

steps.title: Open the FreeHarmony folder
steps.verifierLabel: Your terminal prompt is inside the freeharmony folder

expect.prompt: Has git checked out the pinned commit — does the terminal show a line reading "HEAD is now at 4203743", rather than an error?

hints: If git says pathspec "4203743…" did not match, the terminal is not inside the freeharmony folder yet — run cd freeharmony first.
The "You are in 'detached HEAD' state" paragraph above it is normal: the guide pins a reviewed commit on purpose.

steps.title: Install dependencies
steps.verifierLabel: The install finishes without an error

expect.prompt: Is the dev server ready — does the terminal show a Next.js banner with a "Local: http://localhost:3000" line, rather than still downloading or compiling?

hints: The first run downloads a ~4 MB face model before Next.js starts, so the ready line can take a minute.
If it says port 3000 is in use, Next.js prints the port it picked instead — use that one.

steps.title: Open FreeHarmony
steps.body: If Next.js printed a different port, open that one instead.

steps.title: Try one scan
steps.body: Allow the camera or upload a photo — a second later you get your Harmony score and metrics.
